# Dentistry Decoded (dentistrydecoded.org)

> Demystifying modern dental science. Evidence-based insights, breakthrough technology, and practical oral health tips for clinicians, students, and patients.

## Website Overview
- Primary Domain: https://dentistrydecoded.org
- Handles: @DentistDecoded (Facebook, Twitter/X)
- Topics: Artificial Intelligence in Dentistry, Early Oral Cancer Screening, Pediatric Dentistry, Preventive Care, Restorative Protocols.
- Editorial Standard: All claims must cite peer-reviewed medical and dental literature with direct DOIs.

## Published Articles

### 1. Artificial Intelligence in Dental Treatment Planning and Diagnostic Decision-Making: A 60,000-Scan Meta-Analysis
- URL: https://dentistrydecoded.org/blog/ai-treatment-planning-meta-analysis.html
- Primary Study: Clinical and Experimental Dental Research (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1002/cre2.70343
- Key Evidence Findings: Pooled Sensitivity of 85%, Pooled Specificity of 94%, F1 Accuracy of 90%. AI acts as a diagnostic co-pilot, not a clinician replacement.

### 2. Deep Learning in Pediatric Dentistry: 97% Specificity for Childhood Cavities
- URL: https://dentistrydecoded.org/blog/pediatric-dentistry-cavity-detection-ai.html
- Primary Study: Children (MDPI, 2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.3390/children13010152
- Key Evidence Findings: Pooled Sensitivity of 91%, Pooled Specificity of 97%. Enhances identification of early enamel demineralization on radiographs and clinical photographs to support caries risk prediction.

### 3. Can AI Detect Oral Cancer? A 2026 Systematic Review
- URL: https://dentistrydecoded.org/blog/ai-oral-cancer-detection.html
- Primary Study: Brazilian Dental Science (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.4322/bds.2026.e5017
- Key Evidence Findings: Diagnostic accuracy over 80% across mobile computer vision models. High potential for remote community triage; biopsy remains essential.

### 4. Can AI Design Dental Crowns? A 2026 Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
- URL: https://dentistrydecoded.org/blog/ai-crown-design-restorative-dentistry.html
- Primary Study: Biomedical Engineering and Computational Biology (2026)
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1177/11795972261463709
- Key Evidence Findings: 17 studies analyzed (13 in meta-analysis). 25%–50% reduction in restoration design time (p < 0.001) with internal fit and morphological accuracy comparable to conventional CAD (<100–200 μm, SMD -0.15). Evidence is predominantly in vitro; technician collaboration remains vital in complex cases.

## Educational Disclaimer
Content on Dentistry Decoded is strictly for educational and informational purposes. It does not provide medical or dental advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Patients should always consult a licensed dentist or physician.
